Basically, if you feel like your team has a lead and just needs to blow up fights quickly, go pure damage, triple Rod items. Paladin is the typical "Wall" tank. They keep things on them and generally take fairly low damage. They also do very little damage themselves. Their cooldowns are icing on the cake, in non-raid settings usually, but they are the most durable.

Before Dark Knights, Warriors were the DPS tank. Now, they're more of a happy middle ground. They don't do as much damage as a Dark Knight, but they don't take as much damage either. They aren't as durable as a Paladin, but they deal more damage. Warriors excel at AOE threat and self sustain. Warriors **will** take damage, but they have tools to bring themselves back up. You need to understand your cooldowns fairly well to play a Warrior, but can survive using them improperly.

Dark Knights... oh Dark Knights. I loathe seeing them in DF right now, even as I get closer to 60. A Dark Knight will have a lot of the strengths of Warriors, but even stronger. Their AOE pulling is exceptional. They basically get a combination Flash (Paladin's aoe aggro... does 0 damage)/Overpower (Warrior's cone aggro... does damage in cone), where it will surround them like Flash but do damage like Overpower. Dark Knights need to manage so many things at once and if you let anything slip up... well you better hope your healer has some superpower heals coming your way. It's not uncommon for me to need to spam Benefic 2 and use Essential Dignity on CD on a Dark Knight for the majority of a run's trash. DRKs need to know precisely what they are doing at all times or they will get shredded about as fast as a Dragoon or Ninja.

Story is the big thing here. The other MMO has next to zero story to guide you... you just run zone to zone and collect things for people. In this game, your story will have you kill a literal embodiment of a god *within the first 15 hours of playtime*.

There's no "hybrid" classes (except Arcanist, but even they can't effectively heal as a DPS or DPS as a heal). Healers are expected to DPS (and given tools to effectively do so) during lower periods of damage in order to kill things faster (which, in some cases, is necessary to kill things at all).

All 3 tank classes feel unique enough, but can do everything effectively. Paladin's strength is survival while their weakness is damage. Warrior's strength is aggro while their weakness is survival. Dark Knight's strength is damage while their weakness is survival as well. Warriors are probably the most well-rounded of the tanks, while Paladins are the most simple and forgiving.

Overall, "raiding" is much easier to pick up and leave than the other MMO. You don't have to wait an hour between bosses killing meaningless henchmen.
